prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm golden-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, violin hip hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily curvaceous woman, far beyond any real person; a sharply cinched waist rises out of hips that sweep outward in a single smooth violin-shaped curve, the hips and thick rounded thighs flaring many times wider than the waist and dominating her silhouette from the front and side, a firm high rounded rear, a full round bust balancing the curve above; the line from waist to hip to thigh is one long unbroken curve; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, blunt bob natural black hair — wearing a strapless bandeau of burgundy crinkle cotton gauze soaked in water and oil, glistening droplets running down her bare skin and the wet fabric, a glossy sheen on every wet fold, reduced to the narrowest possible strip only two fingers tall, stretched tightly across the middle of her bust with its ends overlapping at the center front of her chest under a small silver ring, made of two layers of the wet gauze so that it fully and opaquely covering her nipples and areolae, her whole midriff and stomach bare, the wet fabric turning sheer where it clings to the edges of her bust and ribs with her warm golden-brown complexion showing through, paired with a skin-tight micro-mini skirt of lavender crinkle cotton gauze soaked in water and oil, glistening droplets running down her bare skin and the wet fabric, a glossy sheen on every wet fold, its hem at the very top of her thighs with a high slit cut up the right side all the way to the hip bone, the front panel doubled so that it fully covers her, clinging to her hips and thighs and showing their shape, turning sheer where it stretches over her hips with her warm golden-brown complexion showing through, her arms and legs bare. Pose: standing in a wide stance facing the camera straight on, both hands resting on her flared hips, her legs fully in view — most extreme violin hip hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: platform shoes of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, chunky white leather sneakers with white laces, each built on a towering solid white rubber platform sole taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee, worn with white knee-high socks, her feet held level on the flat tops of the platforms, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, coffin nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in hot pink lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of large chandelier earrings of tin and blackened iron as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Indian woman with large almond eyes, strong brows and a defined nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: pushed to the absolute extreme: mirror-bright glass skin dripping with wet liquid shine, blinding liquid highlighter across the cheekbones, nose bridge, forehead and chin, a flushed dewy blush, mirror-gloss lips.
Skin: the skin of a real living woman photographed with a macro lens at close range, every area of her body showing real pores, fine vellus hairs catching the light, a natural soft sheen of skin oils, subtle natural freckles and small beauty marks scattered across her shoulders, arms, stomach and thighs, a gentle uneven skin tone with a faint blush at the knees and elbows, and a soft warm translucency where the light passes through her skin, sharp enough to read every skin texture detail. Her skin shows high gloss body oil, heavily oiled glistening skin, wet-look shine.

Background: a bright coastal clifftop with a grassy path, a waist-high wooden safety rail, standard-height stone steps and a white lighthouse far behind her, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
